verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Whisper only as a speech-to-text model, CLI and API for transcription, translation and language identification. Nothing shows a user-definable rules engine or event-triggered automatic actions. A transcription service could plausibly ship event triggers such as completion callbacks, so the axis applies, but no such capability is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
